parts.text: Plants are also sensitive to gravity.

parts.label: (i)
parts.text: Define the term sensitivity.

parts.label: (ii)
parts.text: Explain the role of plant hormones in gravitropism.

parts.label: (iii)
parts.text:
Gravitropism enables plants to survive in their environment.
Explain how gravitropism enables a plant to survive.

parts.label: (c)
parts.text: Reflexes in animals are also an example of sensitivity.

parts.label: (i)
parts.text: Describe how reflexes in animals differ from sensitivity in plants.

parts.label: (ii)
parts.text:
The pupil reflex is an example of a reflex that occurs in the eye. The eye is a sense
organ.
Define the term sense organ.

parts.label: (a)
parts.text:
A person ate a meal containing starch and fat.
Fig. 2.1 shows some events that occurred after ingesting this meal.
P absorption of nutrients in the villi
Q assimilation of fatty acids in the liver
R breakdown of large food particles by the teeth
S movement of small food particles through the oesophagus
T secretion of amylase from the salivary glands
Fig. 2.1
Put the events in Fig. 2.1 into the correct sequence. One has been done for you.

parts.text: State the names of two cell structures that are involved in making or secreting proteins.

parts.label: (ii)
parts.text: State the name of one component of gastric juice and describe its functions.

parts.text:
There are goblet cells in many parts of the alimentary canal.
State the substance that goblet cells secrete.

parts.label: (ii)
parts.text: State the name of the organ in the alimentary canal where fats are emulsified.

parts.label: (iii)
parts.text: State the name of the structure in the villi where digested fats are absorbed.

parts.text:
A giant rat was discovered in a natural rainforest on Vangunu Island. Scientists wanted
to determine if it was a new species.
Explain how scientists can use tissue samples to classify this rat.

parts.label: (ii)
parts.text:
Giant rats eat coconuts.
Coconuts are grown as a monoculture for human consumption.
Suggest how monocultures of crop plants can result in the extinction of some animals.

plants and explain their benefits.

one example of this.
